data.gene_column: Gene/feature id column (default autodetect: gene, Gene, gene_id, feature, symbol).
data.log2fc_column: log2 fold-change column (default autodetect: avg_log2FC, log2FC, logFC, lfc).
data.pval_column: Adjusted p-value column (default autodetect: p_val_adj, p_val, pvalue, padj, FDR, qval).
data.pct1_column: pct.1 column (default autodetect: pct.1, pct1, pct_1).
data.pct2_column: pct.2 column (default autodetect: pct.2, pct2, pct_2).
data.cluster_column: Cluster/cell-type column for avg_volcano and percent_volcano (default autodetect: cluster, Cluster, celltype).
data.split_column: Optional split.by column for volcano facetting (default autodetect: split.by, split_by, batch, condition).
data.features_include: Alias of rows_include (gene ids to keep).
data.features_exclude: Alias of rows_exclude (gene ids to remove).

plot_mode.de_expr: Expression string for DE classification in volcano mode (default 'avg_log2FC > 0 & p_val_adj < 0.05').
plot_mode.highlight_n: Number of top markers to label per cluster/group (default 5).
plot_mode.rank_by: Ranking expression for avgVolcano topMarkers selection.
plot_mode.cluster_order: Ordered cluster levels for avgVolcano x axis.

labels.title: Plot title.
labels.subtitle: Plot subtitle (volcano mode only).
labels.ylab: Y axis title (volcano default '-log10(p-adjust)'; percent_volcano default 'Log2-Fold Change').

typography.base_size: Base font size passed to themeDefault / theme_classic / theme_bw.

colors.de_colors: Named colors for sigDown, sigUp, Nonsig (avg_volcano) or cluster label colors (percent_volcano).
colors.palette: Gradient palette name for volcano mode (default 'RdBu'; supports RColorBrewer names and viridis options).
colors.palcolor: Explicit color vector override for the volcano gradient.

layers.pnudge_y: Repel y nudge for positive labels (percent_volcano).
layers.nnudge_y: Repel y nudge for negative labels (percent_volcano).

annotations.features_label: Genes to force-label across all modes.
annotations.region_annotations: Volcano-only array of {id,label/text,xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax,...}; coordinates accept numbers, -threshold, threshold, x_min/x_max/y_min/y_max, -Inf, Inf.
annotations.region_annotations_file: Volcano-only CSV/TSV path, absolute or relative to cwd/plugin; --regions is an alias.
annotations.annotation_context: none (default), default_volcano_regions, or a key in annotation_contexts.
annotations.annotation_contexts: Named region arrays used when region_annotations is absent.
annotations.default_volcano_regions: Boolean; generate four screenshot-like regions only when true.
annotations.region_show: Show region rectangles; defaults false when no regions are supplied.
annotations.region_labels: Optional label control/word list for region labels.
annotations.region_layer: background, midground, or foreground (volcano region rectangles).
annotations.annotation_x_nudge: Global annotation x nudge (reserved for file/UI clients).
annotations.annotation_y_nudge: Global annotation y nudge (reserved for file/UI clients).
annotations.point_groups: Volcano-only objects with name, genes/features, color, size, alpha, label, label_x, label_y, label_color.
annotations.feature_groups: Volcano-only mapping of group name to gene array or group object; group colors override DE class and nonsig.

region_object.label: Displayed text; text is an alias.
region_object.xmin: Left boundary; numeric or coordinate alias.
region_object.xmax: Right boundary; numeric or coordinate alias.
region_object.ymin: Bottom boundary; numeric or coordinate alias.
region_object.ymax: Top boundary; numeric or coordinate alias.
region_object.color: Boundary color; border_color is an alias.

axes_and_theme.x_limits: Two-number x limits for predictable placement.
axes_and_theme.y_limits: Two-number y limits for predictable placement.
